title: Evals Explorer public data (explorer/latest.json)
description: The single public data contract behind the Evals Explorer and the project dashboard, written by scripts/explorer_data.py. It is schema_version 1: the contract only added fields to the earlier document. Every field comes from a public input; null means unknown, never zero or empty. scripts/explorer_data.py validates its output against this schema, after `finish`, before writing.

discarded_runs.description: discarded_runs summed over the listed skills, sections and both.

eval_run.description: One scored paired run (scripts/eval_facts.py scored_runs); a guidance run's skill is guidance/<section>. meter_points and account_week_after are null unless evals/public-export.yml include_spend is true.

fixture_queue.description: scripts/fixture_queue.py's report, carried as is; that script decides its rows

spend_file.description: The expected shape of spend/weekly.json on the results branch (written by the dashboard refresh). Not part of this document; explorer_public.build_spend copies only the spend_week keys of each week, and any other key, such as a per-session or per-thread row, is never read.

week.description: the Monday the week starts on

plan.description: the plan name; defaults to the top-level plan

discarded_runs.description: Recorded arm runs a subject's current verdict does not count, by reason (harness/gates.py, DISCARDED RUNS), with their agent cost in US dollars at full precision; cost_usd is a floor when cost_unknown is above 0.

utility_row.description: One row of a subject's run-utility ledger (harness/gates.py, RUN UTILITY): the arm runs of one UTC day, arm model, class and reason.

run_utility.description: A subject's run-utility ledger, null without a verdict (unknown, not zero).

decision.description: One cell version of a subject (harness/gates.py, RUN UTILITY, CELL VERSIONS): its first and last run day, its class and the day of its decision point.

decisions.description: A subject's cell versions and their decisions, null without a verdict.
